rules.statement: A consent judgment admitting rent arrears, which was obtained through fraud by the tenant and possibly with landlord collusion, is a nullity.
rules.supporting_quote: I think therefore that the consent judgment was obtained by fraud on the part of the tenant (and indeed probably of the landlord as well) with a view to depriving of her right of occupation, a person specially protected by law. The admission of arrears which gave the court jurisdiction to enter decree was not made bona fide. The admission was incorrect in fact. The consent judgment is in the circumstances a nullity.
